template.title: Mia and the Kite‑Hidden Toy
template.summary: Mia finds her missing toy with help of a friendly animal.

sentences.text_with_blanks: Mia loved to play with [[slot_toy]] in the park.
One sunny morning, she saw her [[slot_toy]] missing on the swing.
She looked under the slide, over the sandpit, and even at the big oak tree.
Just then, a bright [[slot_color]] kite flew by and made a funny shape in the sky.
Mia thought the kite might have hidden her toy, so she followed it.
The kite landed on a hill, and a gentle [[slot_animal]] was there, munching on a crunchy [[slot_snack]].
The [[slot_animal]] looked at Mia and said, 'I found your [[slot_toy]]!'
Mia felt happy and thanked the [[slot_animal]] with a big smile.
She almost shouted, but she chose to say, 'Thank you, friend!'.
The [[slot_animal]] wagged its tail, and they both laughed.
They sat on the hill, sharing the crunchy [[slot_snack]] while watching the rainbow that formed after the rain.
Mia felt brave and ready for new adventures.
